unit.why: A homiletic-kabbalistic teaching on gemilut hasadim drawing the soul of Abraham, the three daily prayers and three Sabbath meals as illuminations of the patriarchs; no narrative event.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the teaching from the previous division (which cited the Ari/R. Shimon anecdote from Hiddushei HaRim); ends with a heading 'מענין בנין בית' that introduces the story in the next division.
